verdict.rationale: Temporal's docs establish the core workflow/activity/worker model (temporal-docs-3, temporal-docs-14) and even a CLI for tracking batch job progress (temporal-docs-26), implying support for batch-style fan-out, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents child workflow APIs, parallel step composition, or fan-in aggregation patterns. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of child workflow execution, parallel/concurrent step orchestration primitives, and fan-out/fan-in coordination patterns for dynamic batches.
